data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to scan for nearby visible WiFi access points.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to trigger full WiFi scans, retrieve the latest scanned access point results, and listen to a stream of new scan results.
use_when: You need to scan for nearby visible WiFi access points on Android.
You want to listen to a stream of newly available WiFi scan results.
avoid_when: You need robust iOS support, as iOS requires special entitlements and has limited public APIs (stub implementation).
You want to manage network connectivity status or connect to WiFi networks.
strengths: Provides APIs to check platform support and request necessary permissions before scanning.
Supports streaming new scan results via `onScannedResultsAvailable`.
weaknesses: iOS implementation is largely a stub with sane returns and requires special Apple entitlements.
Android scans are subject to system throttling on SDK >= 26.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific configuration and permissions, plus handling special entitlements on iOS if applicable.
